title: Independent ACIS reader artifact refresh and exact-profile execution plan
mode: Current primary-source package, provenance, and immutable source review; research-only
scope: Refresh the independent ACIS reader candidate from cq-acis 0.3.3 to the latest published artifact reviewed on 2026-10-19.
Pin reproducible platform artifacts and define exact-profile boundaries for the existing PAR-07/S8 composed semantic checkpoint.
Separate bare ACIS parsing, DWG/DXF carrier extraction and owner association, geometry-kernel results, and native consumer qualification.

sources.revision: cq-acis 0.3.12; PyPI published 2026-10-16; verified Trusted Publishing provenance identifies source commit e05a8f470d2f6799277f7b7df467d2fc35625889.
sources.observed: The package parses SAT/SAB and converts only supported B-rep profiles through CadQuery/OpenCascade. It requires Python >=3.11 and CadQuery 2.8+. Published platform wheels include macOS ARM64, macOS x86-64, Linux x86-64, Linux ARM64, and Windows x86-64.
sources.limitation: Artifact provenance establishes source/artifact identity, not behavior. The full transitive CadQuery/OCCT environment still needs a lock and runtime capture before execution. No package was installed or run.

sources.project: cq-acis immutable SAB/ASM and geometry documentation
sources.revision: Files inspected at the same immutable source commit attested by the 0.3.12 PyPI publication.
sources.observed: Documented SAB/ASM save profiles are ACIS BinaryFile/4-byte words 21800; ASM BinaryFile4 22000, 22300, 22600, 22700, 22900, and 23200; and BinaryFile8 framing for those ASM versions, with synthetic framing coverage only. Parsing and conversion are separate; unsupported referenced geometry fails conversion. Unknown binary records are retained raw. Reserved-marker history is opaque and is not validated/replayed; the parsed stored table does not establish current Inventor history or Model State.
sources.limitation: A supported version is not whole-layout support. A parse, entity count, primary-body success, opaque raw record, or preview does not prove complete-body semantics or current model state. Synthetic BinaryFile8 coverage cannot qualify native-produced files.

sources.revision: Current project documentation reviewed 2026-10-19; no application or kernel was run.
sources.observed: FreeCAD documents that its stock DXF importer cannot read embedded ACIS solids and that DWG import routes through converter-to-DXF and then a selected importer. FreeCAD uses the OCCT kernel family. cq-acis has a distinct ACIS parser implementation but uses CadQuery/OCCT for shape construction.
sources.limitation: cq-acis parsing and FreeCAD native import are distinct observations but not independent kernel-family evidence. Stock FreeCAD's unsupported ACIS behavior is a consumer boundary, not a libdxfrw parse failure.

sources.revision: Current source/release pages reviewed 2026-10-19; no decoder was run.
sources.observed: cq-acis accepts bare SAT/SAB bytes and does not parse DWG containers, AcDs sections, or entity-to-section owner/key associations. Independent DWG and DXF decoders remain separate prerequisites for extracting and joining carriers.
sources.limitation: No source-handle, owner/key, extraction, or conversion result was obtained in this research pass.

assessment.planImpact: Supersedes the older cq-acis 0.3.3 candidate pin with a verifiable 0.3.12 source/artifact identity and platform wheel hashes. Refines the existing PAR-07/S8 composed gate with exact profile, dependency-lock, carrier-extraction, handle/owner association, all-body conversion, and shared-kernel-lineage requirements. Does not constitute semantic or native qualification.

implementationReadiness: Use cq-acis 0.3.12 only at the existing composed PAR-07/S8 semantic checkpoint; verify selected wheel SHA-256 and provenance, then lock Python 3.11+, CadQuery, OCCT, and all transitive dependencies.
Keep cq-acis and its geometry dependencies external to libdxfrw, standard build, routine CI, and per-slice validation.
Admit only the exact SAT/SAB/ASM save profile and documented geometry types; enumerate all body references and reject unsupported/raw referenced geometry for a semantic pass.

For DWG-origin cases, use an independent pinned DWG decoder for section payload and source-entity owner/key association; for DXF cases, use a separate strict DXF decoder. Feed bare payload to cq-acis only after carrier identity and association are recorded.

Compare against a locally generated, independently authored analytic manifest for every expected body, including source units/tolerance, topology, validity, shell closure/orientation, bounds, volume, and placement.

Treat opaque history, synthetic-only BinaryFile8 coverage, the peer's separately licensed test corpus, primary-body success, and mesh/STEP preview as non-qualifying for full model/history/native support.
Record parser independence separately from OCCT kernel lineage; do not count cq-acis and FreeCAD as independent kernel votes.

Keep native FreeCAD Linux/Windows converter/importer checks and selected macOS ARM64 CAD Assistant observation as separate composed consumer routes. A route failure or unavailable input leaves the claim unqualified and does not block local implementation.
Do not commit downloaded third-party sample drawings; use existing admitted repository files or temporary controls authored locally from scratch.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web review plus plan crosswalk
method.limitations: The selected reader and platform artifacts are now reproducibly identified, but the dependency environment, runtime behavior, input-profile coverage, source association, semantic output, and native consumer acceptance remain untested. Package documentation and release provenance do not promote any support claim.
